enrichment_rules.description: Premium/luxury jewelry stores are gift-friendly, romantic, and suited for special occasions
Mid-range jewelry/accessories are accessible gift options
Kids and baby stores are family-friendly, practical shopping
Premium beauty stores are strong gift and self-treat options
Mid-range beauty/home fragrance stores work for casual gifting
Quick-service and fast-casual dining are suited for quick visits and pre/post movie
Casual dining restaurants suit families and relaxed outings
Premium/fine dining suits dates, special occasions, and couples
Dessert spots are after-meal and after-movie add-ons
Cafes are solo-friendly, meeting spots, and quick-visit options
Entities in the Entertainment Zone get cinema-proximity tags
Entities in the Food Court get food-court proximity tags
Budget fashion stores suit practical shopping and budget-conscious families
Premium electronics stores are strong gift options for tech lovers
Kids entertainment venues are key for family visits and child activities

when_to_recommend: User looking for a gift for girlfriend, wife, or mother
Anniversary or special occasion shopping
User wants premium or luxury jewelry
Bridal jewelry shopping
User mentions gold or diamond
avoid_if: User on a tight budget
User looking for kids items only
User wants quick practical shopping
profiles.concierge_notes: L'azurde is a Saudi brand — highlight this for visitors who appreciate local craftsmanship. Excellent for bridal jewelry and milestone gifts. Suggest engraving for personalization. Pairs well with a romantic dinner at Eataly afterward.

when_to_recommend: User shopping for baby or children's items
New parents looking for essentials
Gift for a child or baby shower
User mentions kids, baby, or maternity
avoid_if: User looking for adult fashion or luxury items
User looking for entertainment only
No child context in the conversation
profiles.concierge_notes: Mothercare is the go-to for baby essentials. Located near the Family Room for convenience — mention this to parents. Offers car seat fitting service which is valuable for new parents. Good pairing with Billy Beez or KidZania for kids' entertainment afterward.

when_to_recommend: User looking for a romantic dinner spot
Anniversary or date night dining
User wants Italian cuisine
Special occasion meal
User wants upscale but not overly formal
avoid_if: User wants a quick bite
User is on a tight budget
User needs kid-focused fast dining
User is rushing before a movie
profiles.concierge_notes: Eataly is the top romantic dining option in the mall. Open kitchen adds to the experience. Suggest the private dining area for anniversaries. The attached Italian grocery is a nice post-dinner browse. Pairs beautifully with jewelry shopping at L'azurde as part of a date plan.

when_to_recommend: User wants a quick meal before or after a movie
Family looking for kid-friendly quick food
User mentions burgers, shakes, or quick lunch
User is on the Second floor near Food Court or heading to Third floor
avoid_if: User wants a fine dining or romantic experience
User looking for healthy or light options only
User wants a leisurely sit-down meal
profiles.concierge_notes: Shake Shack is the ideal pre/post-movie meal — close to the escalators up to VOX Cinemas. 20-minute meal time makes it perfect for tight schedules. Kids love the milkshakes. Suggest the Shack Burger for first-timers.

when_to_recommend: User looking for beauty or fragrance gifts
User wants skincare recommendations
Gift for girlfriend, wife, or friend
User browsing beauty products
User mentions makeup, perfume, or skincare
avoid_if: User on a tight budget looking for essentials
User not interested in beauty products
Male user shopping only for self with no interest in beauty
profiles.concierge_notes: Sephora is a top gift destination — the gift sets are curated and ready to go. Beauty advisor can help personalize choices. Currently running Spring Beauty Sale (20% off selected items). Mention the fragrance sampling for undecided gift buyers.

when_to_recommend: User looking for fashion or clothing
User wants trending or affordable fashion
Family shopping trip
User mentions Zara specifically
avoid_if: User wants luxury or high-end only
User not interested in fashion
profiles.concierge_notes: Zara currently has End of Season Sale (up to 50% off). First store after Main Entrance — easy stop for fashion browsing. New arrivals weekly. Has a kids section for family shoppers.

when_to_recommend: User looking for affordable family fashion
Budget-conscious shopping
User wants basic wardrobe staples
User mentions H&M or budget fashion
avoid_if: User wants premium or luxury only
profiles.concierge_notes: H&M is the best budget-friendly fashion option. Great for stocking up on basics for the whole family. Has a sustainable line for eco-conscious shoppers. Opposite Zara for easy comparison shopping.

when_to_recommend: User wants to buy electronics or gadgets
Gift for a tech-savvy person
User needs Apple product support (Genius Bar)
User mentions iPhone, iPad, MacBook, or Apple
avoid_if: User on a tight budget for non-tech items
User only looking for fashion or dining
profiles.concierge_notes: Apple Store offers Genius Bar support — useful for visitors with device issues. Today at Apple workshops are free and engaging. AirPods and accessories make excellent last-minute gifts. Engraving available on select products.

when_to_recommend: User wants to watch a movie
Family looking for entertainment
Date night plan
User mentions cinema, movies, IMAX, or VOX
avoid_if: User only looking for shopping or dining
User has very young infants (no infant screenings)
profiles.concierge_notes: VOX Cinemas is the entertainment anchor. Gold screens for romantic date nights — suggest for anniversary plans. Kids screen for families. IMAX for blockbusters. Currently showing Desert Kingdoms (family), Starlight Romance (couples), and Cosmic Explorers (kids). Weekend combo deal available.

when_to_recommend: Family looking for traditional Saudi food
Group dining with generous portions
User wants authentic local cuisine
User mentions kabsa, mandi, or Saudi food
avoid_if: User wants quick service only
User looking for international/Western cuisine
User wants a romantic fine dining setting
profiles.concierge_notes: Al Romansiah is the local favorite for authentic Saudi dining. Private dining section available for families who prefer privacy. Large portions ideal for sharing. Near the prayer room — convenient for families during prayer times.

when_to_recommend: User wants a family restaurant with variety
User specifically craves cheesecake or American food
Birthday or celebration dinner
User wants a large menu with many options
avoid_if: User wants a very quick meal
User wants authentic local cuisine only
profiles.concierge_notes: Cheesecake Factory works for almost any group thanks to the huge menu. Perfect for indecisive groups. The cheesecake is a must-try dessert — mention it as a post-shopping reward. Weekend brunch is popular.

when_to_recommend: User wants coffee or a quick drink
Solo visitor looking for a comfortable spot
User needs WiFi for work
Meeting spot suggestion
avoid_if: User wants a full meal
User looking for unique local coffee
profiles.concierge_notes: Starbucks is near the Main Entrance — suggest as a starting point or meeting spot. Opens earlier than most stores (7 AM) for early visitors. Good for a caffeine stop before a shopping marathon.

when_to_recommend: After a movie, suggest ice cream
Kids asking for a treat
Post-shopping sweet reward
User mentions ice cream or dessert
avoid_if: User looking for a full meal
User wants healthy options only
profiles.concierge_notes: Baskin-Robbins is the perfect add-on dessert stop. Near the escalators to the Entertainment Zone — suggest after a movie. Birthday cakes available for spontaneous celebrations. Budget-friendly treat for kids.

when_to_recommend: User looking for sportswear or sneakers
Gift for a fitness enthusiast
Teen shopping
User mentions Nike, sneakers, or athletic wear
avoid_if: User wants formal or luxury fashion
profiles.concierge_notes: Nike flagship has the latest sneaker drops — teens love it. Shoe customization service available. Good gift option for active/fitness-minded recipients.

when_to_recommend: User looking for an affordable jewelry gift
Charm bracelet customization
Quick gift pickup
User mentions Pandora, charms, or bracelet
avoid_if: User wants high-end fine jewelry (gold/diamonds)
User looking for men's items only
profiles.concierge_notes: Pandora is a great mid-range gift alternative to L'azurde. Charm customization makes it personal and meaningful. Quick to shop — great for last-minute gifts. In the same corridor as Sephora and L'azurde for a gift-shopping path.

when_to_recommend: User looking for home fragrance or candles
Gift for a friend or coworker
User wants body care products
Last-minute gift that smells great
avoid_if: User wants high-end beauty/skincare (suggest Sephora instead)
profiles.concierge_notes: Bath & Body Works is an excellent last-minute gift option — gift sets are ready-wrapped. Mix-and-match deals make it budget-friendly. Seasonal collections create urgency. Good fallback when Sephora feels too premium.

when_to_recommend: User shopping for home decor or furniture
Wedding or housewarming gift
User mentions home, interior design, or Pottery Barn
avoid_if: User on a tight budget
User looking for personal fashion or beauty
profiles.concierge_notes: Pottery Barn has an interior design service — useful for serious home shoppers. Gift registry available for weddings. Located near Mothercare in the family/home wing.
